{{Top|leg}}
'''Darwikian climbing pads''' were a form of [[Glove/Legends|glove]] developed for explorers and daredevils who climbed [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] and cliffs. Each pad was formed into a wrinkled collection of grooves and ridges, which provided climbers with enhanced gripping ability. It originated from the [[Darwikia system/Legends|Darwikia system]].<ref name="Tatooine Ghost">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>
